sloka: नैवायोध्यां गमिष्यामो न गमिष्याम दण्डकान् ।कुशलं भरतस्यास्तु रामस्यास्तु तथा सुखम् ॥ २.९१.५८॥
transliteration: naivāyodhyāṁ gamiṣyāmo na gamiṣyāma daṇḍakān ।kuśalaṁ bharatasyāstu rāmasyāstu tathā sukham ॥ 2.91.58॥

translations.english: The horserider no longer recognised the horse or the mahout the elephant and the whole army was inebriated with drinking and pleasure.
